capabilities: Convert selected plain URLs into Markdown links using page titles
Fetch HTML titles including og:title and twitter:title metadata
Auto-name pasted plain-text URLs when the setting is enabled
Skip URLs already inside Markdown links and fall back gracefully offline
extras: Installed from source only; the URL-matching regex is hard-coded and some sites block title fetching, so titles may be missing or unreliable.
problem: Pasted plain URLs stay unlabeled, so users must manually visit each page and craft a Markdown link title.
summary: Link namer that converts plain URLs in selected text into Markdown links titled with each page's HTML title.
